description: US federal prevailing wage determinations from SAM.gov (Department of Labor). Search active Davis-Bacon (construction) or Service Contract Act determinations by state, county or text, or open one determination (e.g. TX20260253 or 2015-5245) to get every classification with its hourly rate and fringe benefit, the counties covered, construction type, revision and publish date. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

occupation.description: With wd: keep only classifications containing this text, e.g. electrician

query.description: Search text, e.g. a county name (Harris) or a service (janitorial)

type.description: Search: dba = Davis-Bacon construction (default), sca = Service Contract Act, cba = collective bargaining

wd.description: One determination number: Davis-Bacon like TX20260253, SCA like 2015-5245. Returns its rates

name: gov_sam_gov_wage_determinations
title: Gov Sam Gov Wage Determinations
